title: Validation Runner Pool Capacity and Stale-Run Containment
owner_directive: Add multiple self-hosted runner capacity so running processes do not block later work; keep obsolete runs from consuming validation capacity; make this durable operations behavior.
decisions: Treat each self-hosted validation label set as a pool; any idle matching isolated runner service may accept a job.
Additional runner instances require separate installation/work directories and provide throughput only; correctness does not depend on runner count.
Move repository selector/health and deterministic receipt comparison to hosted Linux when they have no workstation-local dependency.

Scope concurrency to the immutable candidate head: duplicate runs of the same head cancel, while obsolete heads cannot block newer candidates; exact-head evidence prevents stale results from being consumed.
Run deterministic cross-platform comparison only after both required platform validation jobs succeed.
Do not treat runner queue/process/cancellation observations as material project progress or lane-state receipts.
next_action: Resume the already-started GPR-10 tranche against the repaired validation pipeline.
